title: Genomic Sequence Extractor
description: In computational biology, researchers often look for how many times a target genetic marker sequence appears as a distinct subsequence inside a larger subject strand. Given two strings, source and target, return the number of distinct subsequences of source which equals target.
constraints: source and target consist of English letters.
output_format: An integer representing the count of distinct subsequences

examples.explanation:
As shown below, there are 3 ways you can generate "rabbit" from source. (The uppercase letters indices show the selected characters):
ra[b]bbit
rab[b]bit
rabb[b]it
There are 5 ways to generate "bag" from "babgbag" using different index combinations.
